title: Histone deacetylase 8 in focus: Decoding structural prerequisites for innovative epigenetic intervention beyond hydroxamates.
authors: Khatun, Samima; Dasgupta, Indrasis; Sen, Sourish; Amin, Sk Abdul; Qureshi, Insaf Ahmed; Jha, Tarun; Gayen, Shovanlal
one_liner_zh: 该文研究HDAC8抑制剂的结构要求与QSAR建模，对象为酶-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Histone deacetylase 8 (HDAC8) inhibitors play a pivotal role in epigenetic regulation. Numerous HDAC8 inhibitors (HDAC8is), that are non-hydroxamates have been identified to date, and a few of them exhibit antiproliferative activity that is on par with hydroxamates. While many non-hydroxamate-based HDAC8is have demonstrated selectivity, hydroxamate-based HDAC8is, like Vorinostat and TSA, have a tendency of non-specificity among the different HDAC isoforms. Moreover, because of the unfavorable toxic side effects, there are significant concerns surrounding the use of hydroxamate derivatives as therapeutic agents in cancer as well as other chronic diseases. Consequently, the research on non-hydroxamate-based HDAC8is is of utmost priority. In the present study, a comprehensive study was presented to unravel the structural requirements of non-hydroxamate-based HDAC8is from a diverse set of 866 compounds. The study utilized Classification-based Quantitative Structure-Activity Relationship (QSAR) analysis, incorporating Bayesian classification, Recursive partitioning, and other machine learning methods to pinpoint the key structural features essential for HDAC8 inhibition. To underscore and gain deeper insights into the identified structural features, molecular docking, and molecular dynamic (MD) simulation studies were conducted. The integration of these computational approaches unveiled key structural motifs essential for potent HDAC8 inhibitory activity, shedding light on the molecular basis of HDAC8 inhibition using non-hydroxamates.
abstract_zh: 组蛋白去乙酰化酶8（HDAC8）抑制剂在表观遗传调控中发挥关键作用。迄今为止，已鉴定出许多非羟肟酸类HDAC8抑制剂（HDAC8is），其中少数表现出与羟肟酸类相当的抗增殖活性。尽管许多基于非羟肟酸的HDAC8is已显示出选择性，但基于羟肟酸的HDAC8is，如伏立诺他（Vorinostat）和曲古抑菌素A（TSA），在不同HDAC亚型之间往往缺乏特异性。此外，由于不利的毒性副作用，羟肟酸衍生物作为癌症及其他慢性疾病治疗药物的使用存在重大担忧。因此，对基于非羟肟酸的HDAC8is的研究具有最高优先性。在本研究中，通过对866种多样化化合物进行综合分析，揭示了非羟肟酸类HDAC8is的结构要求。该研究利用基于分类的定量构效关系（QSAR）分析，结合贝叶斯分类、递归划分及其他机器学习方法，以确定对HDAC8抑制至关重要的关键结构特征。为强调并深入理解所识别的结构特征，进行了分子对接和分子动力学（MD）模拟研究。这些计算方法的整合揭示了强效HDAC8抑制活性所必需的关键结构基序，阐明了使用非羟肟酸类化合物抑制HDAC8的分子基础。
